data.name: Lucianetta
data.long_meaning: From the Latin name Lucianus, derived from lucere, meaning 'to shine'. In Christianity, Lucian is a male name associated with Saint Lucian, a 3rd-century martyr. The feminine form Lucianetta has a similar meaning and may evoke imagery of a bright and shining woman or girl.
